name: John A. Logan
role: U.S. Senator from Illinois; 1884 Republican vice-presidential nominee
bio: John A. Logan, the Illinois senator and Union general, was James G. Blaine's running mate in 1884, and the Cow Boy predicted their election. It reported his re-election to the Senate in May 1885.
